name: aquine-skills
description: Takes a web app from wherever it is today — an empty repository, or one already live on somebody else's stack — to something that keeps shipping because a person described what they wanted. No code template: the app is scaffolded by the framework's own CLI at setup time.

plugins.name: webapp
plugins.description: Agentic web app delivery for a non-technical owner: scaffold on Vercel or adopt a live app wherever it already runs, then evolve it from plain-language requests.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Keep one ready primary PR as the merge target while publishing a parallel draft review stack with tracked feedback and automatic cleanup.
